title: onboard-novar-16b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard Novar-16B v1.0 to the model registry, add curated performance profiles, and wire up changelog/release-note automation for future model updates. Motivation: Novar-16B provides a strong cost/quality tradeoff for long-context instruction workloads we see in customer benchmarks (notably content generation pipelines). This PR introduces model metadata, performance profiles (latency/throughput/kv-cache behavior), and a small automation pipeline that appends a generated release note to the models changelog when metadata or perf profiles are updated. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (name, family, tokenizer, params, supported precisions) - [x] Add perf profiles (sequence length matrix, batch sizes, throughput/latency targets) - [x] Add changelog generation script and workflow - [x] Add CI validation for metadata schema and perf profile sanity checks - [x] Add docs blurb to registry README Changes are intentionally small and self-contained under model-metadata/ and perf-profiles/ so they can be reviewed independently. Performance summary (internal bench on p4d.24xlarge, nvfp16, KV cache warm): - 1-token latency (p95): 36ms - 256-token median throughput: 220 tokens/sec - Example cost impact: ~18% lower per-token GPU time vs baseline-13b for conversational summarization workload Notable decisions: - Default supported precisions: fp16, nvfp16, int8-ggml (quant profiles provided) - We include a recommended quantization profile (nv_q8) and recommended batch/batching windows for low-latency SLOs - Changelog automation: scripts/generate_model_changelog.py reads a changelog template, pulls model metadata/perf summary and appends a structured entry to registry/CHANGELOG.md. The workflow .github/workflows/model-changelog.yml triggers on push to model-metadata/* and perf-profiles/* and requires CI validation to pass. Rollout plan: Merge to main, run automated registry validation job in staging, and then schedule a small deploy to hosted catalog at 2026-02-20 08:00 UTC. Follow-ups: - Add extended perf sweep for 1024/2048 token batches (ENG-4800) - Hook the changelog generator to the release-notes tool chain to surface changelogs in product UI (PM-210).
